correctness.rationale: A self-contained reduction pI-minus-three-projectors shows A_E=p-lambda_max(G_E) and upper bound p. All translation occupancy cases are exhausted. Quadratic Gauss sums give the exact gauge-invariant triangle; the cubic Gram polynomial gives its maximal eigenvalue. Arithmetic phase quantization and constructive square-P slopes establish global sharpness for both congruence classes. The saved standalone script checked 308704 complete three-erasure sets and 8580 independently evaluated triangle products at six primes; finite checks corroborate but are not the proof. The p=3 exception, normalization, and other limitations are explicit.

value.rationale: Exact deterministic erasure resilience is a natural operational and analytic invariant of the widely studied Alltop Gabor frame. The formula establishes sharp reconstruction condition numbers for all primes p>=5, with constructive attaining erasures, replacing coherence-level bounds by a genuine quadratic-Gauss phase obstruction for p=3 mod4. The congruence transition is motivated by the inherent Gauss multiplier rather than an arbitrary tiny numerical improvement. No claim about arbitrary windows or larger erasure sizes is made.
